harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Inventory application is running persistently on node2 and node3 at port 8080. HAProxy on node1 load-balances port 80 round-robin across both backends. Final verification returned HTTP 200, six alternating node2/node3 responses, four inventory rows, and valid API data. All nodes passed serial reboot persistence testing with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Deployed the Python 3.9 inventory UI, health endpoint, and JSON API on node2 and node3.
Created enabled systemd services with automatic restart and persistent TCP/8080 firewall access.
Installed and configured HAProxy on node1 with round-robin balancing and active backend health checks.
Enabled HAProxy and persistent HTTP firewall access on node1.
Retained AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 on every node.
Restarted each node individually and verified boot identity changes and complete recovery.
